title: ervilia cassubica
intro: Ervilia cassubica, commonly known as  sweet woodruff, is a flowering perennial plant native to Europe. It has been used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating wounds, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of sweet woodruff include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Ervilia cassubica include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses as a natural remedy.
